data.exact_reserve_text: The result for the year included net prior year reserve releases of GBP 2.1m (2020: reserve release of GBP 4.8m) and benefited the combined ratio by 1.5% (2020: benefit of 3.9%). The treaty reinsurance classes of business contributed most of the prior year reserve releases.
data.standardized_narrative: The gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 was GBP 403.686m. Analysis of the syndicate's gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2014-2019 indicates a net adverse movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 7.57m (about 1.9% of opening gross reserves). This contrasts with the Managing Agent's narrative which reports net prior year reserve releases of GBP 2.1m (net of reinsurance), with treaty reinsurance classes contributing most of the net releases-indicating that reinsurance recoveries and favourable developments on some years offset gross adverse movements.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement line item was provided. The gross prior-year movement was calculated from the published gross claims development table (claims triangle) on page 47. The Managing Agent narrative reports a NET prior year release of GBP 2.1m (net of reinsurance); the gross triangle calculation (used here) shows a net strengthening of older years of GBP 7.572m. The difference reflects reinsurance recoveries and scope differences (gross vs net). All triangle values are presented in GBP 000 in the report and were converted to millions for this output.
